public.text: Bringing capacity in-house is presented as the preferred trajectory. Some specialist capabilities may be more sustainably pooled regionally or maintained through long-term partnerships.
public.suggestedRevision: Define which capabilities require internal institutional ownership and which may be accessed through accountable external or regional arrangements.
